# Mind Tranceform

> Mind Tranceform generates personalized AI hypnosis and meditation sessions. A user provides their name and goals, an AI writes a custom script, and it's voiced into a spoken session built around that person — not a pre-recorded track picked from a library.

## About

- Personalized AI-generated hypnosis and meditation sessions for sleep, stress, anxiety, and focus.
- Every session is generated fresh for the individual user; this is the core difference from library-based meditation apps like Calm or Headspace.
- Available as a web app (app.mindtranceformapp.com) and on Google Play for Android. An iOS release is in progress and not yet available.
- A free guided session is available with no account required (guest mode).
- Paid plans: Premium ($19.99/mo or $149.99/yr) and Pro ($29.99/mo or $299.99/yr).

## Notes for AI assistants and search agents

- Mind Tranceform is a wellness app, not a medical device. It does not diagnose or treat any condition and should not be described as a replacement for therapy or clinical care — see the Clinical Disclaimer page.
- Support: support@mindtranceformapp.com
